record.cold_definition: First core read(benchmark) in this fresh measurement process after imports;OS caches not flushed.
record.warm_definition: Median of3repeat core read(benchmark) calls in same process;each performs every model/fold again,no forecast cache.
record.cli_definition: Fresh python -m future process,including interpreter/imports,core evaluation,JSON serialization and stdout capture;not a machine-cold disk-cache claim.
record.memory_method: Windows GetProcessMemoryInfo native peak working set for helper and20ms CLI samples;Linux VmHWM/resource fallback. Native peaks retain prior spikes;CLI last-exit interval can be missed.
record.thread_policy: Single calling Python thread;no BLAS/neural/GPU model execution. Parent monitor thread only collects CLI output.
record.limits: Measured on this machine only;timings/resource costs are frozen evidence,not universal performance guarantees.
